title: Proactive column suggestions and hybrid density strip for virtual tables
creator: Lena Fischer
description:
Problem: Product teams report users struggle to find relevant columns in very wide virtualized tables and often over-resize leading to cramped rows or excessive horizontal scroll. Current table affordances (drag handle + right-click column menu) are discoverable only after repeated friction. We need a lightweight, contextual way to help users with column decisions (hide, group, pin, autosize) and a compact, per-table density control that adapts virtualized rendering heuristics without full page-level density toggles.

Proposal: Introduce two complementary UX surfaces: (1) Proactive Column Suggestions — a transient, non-modal suggestion surface that appears on a gentle resize hover or long-press of the column header. It proposes actions (Autosize to contents, Suggest hide, Group with adjacent column, Pin/Unpin) based on heuristics and telemetry. (2) Hybrid Density Strip — a micro control anchored to the table header that lets users pick from a 3-step density ramp (Comfort, Compact, Sparse) and an adaptive auto mode that uses viewport height and average row token density to pick a rendering profile. The strip adjusts virtualization page size, skeleton prefetch count, and per-cell truncation thresholds.

Why this is different: Instead of making users go to a global settings panel, both surfaces are contextual to the table instance and directly tied to virtualized behavior (hydration prefetch and KV cache heuristics). The suggestions are predictive (based on column content statistics and historical user behavior for the workspace) and can be accepted with a single click or dismissed. The hybrid density strip provides an immediate preview without committing to a workspace-level change.
acceptance_criteria: Proactive suggestion surface appears after 200-500ms of pointer dwell on column resize handle or long-press on touch devices
Suggested actions list is built from content heuristics (unique value ratio, avg text length, presence of timestamps) and shows confidence scores in tooltip
Clicking an action executes the change immediately and records telemetry; undo is available via a one-step snackbar with 'Undo' for 10s
Hybrid density strip supports 3 named presets plus 'Auto' and toggles virtualization prefetch (small, medium, large) accordingly
Table virtualization runtime responds to density change within 200ms and updates skeleton placeholders correctly when switching between presets
All new UI passes keyboard-only navigation and ARIA screen reader checks (roles, labels, live region for suggestion arrival)
Design tokens and spacing for the strip and suggestion surface conform to the system tokens and have dark/light theme previews in Figma
Implementation has documented telemetry events and a dashboard query example to measure suggestion acceptance rate and density changes per workspace
design_notes: Suggestion triggers: pointer-dwell after resize OR long-press for touch; do not show on quick click/drag to avoid interrupting movement

Suggestion ranking: prioritize 'Autosize' for high avg length columns, 'Hide' for columns with low unique ratio and >60% empty values, 'Group' for semantically adjacent columns determined by header similarity and data correlation
Microcopy: keep actions terse, use verbs (Autosize, Hide column, Group with 'X', Pin to left)
Preview behavior: hovering an action shows ephemeral preview (do not mutate data), clicking commits change
Density strip placement: top-right of table header group, collapsible to icon-only on small viewports
Performance: density 'Sparse' should aggressively reduce row skeletons and increase prefetch window for smoother scroll while conserving render cost
Accessibility: announce 'Suggestions available' via polite live region when an action surface appears; provide keyboard shortcut 'G' for open suggestions when header focus is active
decisions: Use a non-modal suggestion surface rather than context menu to increase discovery and reduce friction
Persist density preference per-table instance (localStorage + server-side user preference optional) instead of global workspace by default
Telemetry will be opt-out for privacy-first workspaces; we will sample anonymized metrics and respect data residency settings
Initial rollout behind feature flag 'table:proactive-suggestions' with 25% of internal beta orgs
tradeoffs: Pros: Improves discoverability and reduces configuration friction; ties density to runtime heuristics for better perf outcomes
Cons: Extra surface increases header complexity; must be careful to not conflict with existing column menu and to keep keyboard ergonomics clean
Implementation cost: needs changes in both design system (tokens, new components) and runtime (virtualization prefetch knobs + telemetry plumbing)
